aggregation: Joint permutation within each feature group at its biological unit (promoter, RBS, or promoter-RBS pair); repeated rows within a unit receive the same values. permutation repeats averaged within fold, followed by equal-fold mean and SD across the fixed outer folds.
interpretation: Positive delta_spearman and delta_mae_log indicate that permuting the group degraded predictions. This is model reliance, not causality.
